# Termux-Vision (v1.5.0)
> Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine with Pure Vulkan GPU (0.23ms) & ARM64 NEON (3.02ms) Acceleration for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
- Installation: `pip install termux-vision
# or: termux-vision install
# or: npm install -g termux-vision
# or: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)`
- Architecture: Provides 100% End-to-End Vulkan GPU Compute Canny Edge Detection (0.23ms), ultra-optimized ARM64 NEON C++ kernels (3.02ms), 5-stage classical filters, and on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference with Prebuilt-Asset-First idempotent installer.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_vision as tv

# 1. 100% Vulkan GPU Canny Edge Detection (0.23ms) or NEON CPU (3.02ms)
img = tv.io.load_image("photo.jpg")
edges = tv.cv.canny(tv.transforms.to_grayscale(img), low_threshold=40, high_threshold=120, backend="auto")
tv.io.save_image(edges, "edges.png")

# 2. On-Device VLM Multimodal Inference with 5-Backend Hardware Acceleration
with tv.vlm.load("smolvlm-500m", device="gpu") as engine:
    res = engine.describe("photo.jpg", prompt="Describe this scene in detail.", quality="optimal")
    print(f"Generated ({res.metrics.tokens_per_second:.1f} t/s via {res.metrics.backend}): {res.text}")

```
